extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Cigna plan available in Lee County has a $30 monthly premium, a $410 drug deductible and a $5700 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan benefits before the disclaimer, which is compliant. The agent also collected the Scope of Appointment and scheduled a plan review, both of which were done in a timely manner.
composition.coaching_note: While the agent's disclaimer was delivered correctly, it could be more effective by being stated earlier in the call. Grace could say, 'Before we discuss the plan details, I need to inform you that we do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.' This ensures the disclaimer is heard before any benefits are discussed.
